claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being cranked over by hand or with a starter.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing a specific part or have a damaged component.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine with all covers and components removed.

risks.risk: The engine may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine identification plate (engine code) or a photo of the engine installed in a car.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic engine without a specific model

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate (engine code) usually found on the engine block.
Video of the engine being cranked over to check for smooth operation.
Photo of the engine with all covers and components removed to check for missing parts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
